mechanism: Both drugs prolong QT interval; ondansetron inhibits hERG potassium channels and dronedarone is a Class III antiarrhythmic, creating additive cardiac electrophysiologic effects with torsades de pointes risk.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, obtain baseline ECG, monitor QTc interval, ensure electrolyte normalization (K+, Mg2+), and use lowest effective ondansetron doses with cardiac monitoring.
